title: Issue #208: [P1] Verify compute result attestations independently and block unsafe settlement
content:
State: open

## Goal
Ensure protected actions and settlement cannot proceed on unattributed, stale or insufficiently verified compute results.

## Scope
Implement attestation validation against the normative contract, identity/revocation status, freshness, input/result binding and an explicit correctness assurance model.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Valid attestation is bound to task_id, run_id, node_id, input_hash and artifact_hash.
- [ ] Invalid signature, unknown/revoked signer, stale/replayed attestation and mismatched hashes are rejected.
- [ ] Missing or failed required verification blocks settlement and protected downstream actions.
- [ ] Tests distinguish signature/attribution validity from computation correctness.
- [ ] The verifier's assurance model and residual trust assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Exact-SHA CI/integration evidence is attached.

## Dependencies
Normative attestation/identity contracts; multi-node worker path for full integration.
